title: Split-Screen Real Estate Search, Parcel Polygon & Commute Explorer
name: Split-Screen Real Estate Search, Parcel Polygon & Commute Explorer
user_prompt: Build a Zillow-style split-screen real estate property search, lot-boundary, and neighborhood commute explorer in San Francisco. Display a filterable property card list synchronized with an interactive vector Google Map rendering custom HTML price-pill Advanced Markers (with bidirectional hover highlighting), Marker Clustering, and cadastral lot/parcel polygon outlines on selected listings. Include a Terra Draw 'Draw Search Area' polygon filter on the map, satellite/roadmap toggle, an embedded Street View neighborhood preview, nearby schools/groceries/transit discovery within 5km via Places API (New), and a workplace 'Commute Time Calculator' using the Routes API route matrix to show driving and transit travel times from the selected property.
